newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average falls more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average falls more than 50 points.

text.p: Blue chip stocks fell more than 50 points in early trading Wednesday, pulled down by a slumping bond market.

Shortly after 10 a.m. EDT, the Dow Jones industrial average was off 50.22 points at 7,261.93, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading. The Nasdaq composite index, laden with high-tech issues, was up 3.25 points at 1,388.16, recovering from Tuesday's sharp selloff.
